title: The North-China Daily News January 5, 1926

page_data.en:
THE NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, JANUARY 5, 1926
（印：...）
No. 6902
Date... 5/1/26

A CANTON GENERAL
ON CANTON

No Real Bolshevism: Borodin
Merely an Adviser: The Red
Labours for Peace

"There is absolutely no truth in the allegations that Canton is Bolshevik and is governed by Comrade Borodin and his Communists or that Gen. Chiang Kai-shek (Commander-in-Chief of the Cantonese army) is 'Red,'" said Gen. Wu Te-cheng, commander of the 1st Canton Army and Commissioner of Public Safety in Canton, when interviewed by a representative of the "North-China Daily News."

Comrade Borodin was simply a political adviser to the Canton Administration, remarked Gen. Wu, and had no say in the affairs of the province at all. He might have some personal influence over some members of the Government but that did not mean to say that he dictated to the Government. "I am a member of the Government," said Gen. Wu, "but I am never governed by Borodin or any other foreigner. Borodin's position as political adviser gives him the right to make suggestions but it gives him no power in the administration. It is absolutely untrue to say that he is dictating to the government. Some individual may listen to his advice, but that is their own business. It is true that Communist propaganda is being spread in the south, but that also is carried on individual lines and not by the government."

No Real Bolshevism

"Real Bolshevism," continued the General, "does not exist in Canton. There is peace and order in the province such as has never been experienced since the Revolution. Business is being carried on normally. If Bolshevism existed, all properties would be nationalized, as well as women, and all buildings and stores, etc., such as Sincere's and the Sun Co., would be seized by the maddened masses. The province would be in a state of turmoil."

Referring to Gen. Chiang Kai-shek, the Commissioner said that here was a true, brave, honest and patriotic man, who really had the interests of the Chinese people at heart. There was absolutely no truth in the allegations that he was a Bolshevik. His men were really well-trained, many had studied in the Whampoa Military Academy, and they were good and well-behaved fighters. Their actions did not arouse the antagonism of the people. Unlike other troops, they did not resort to squeeze and other illegal taxation. They only fought when forced to and then they generally were victorious. They wanted peace, they wished to maintain peace.

That Weary Old Yoke

Canton, the base of the Revolution and the anti-imperialist stronghold, desired to achieve a national revolution and to release the Chinese people from the yoke of the foreigners. In order to establish an ideal government, the Chinese must do away with militarism and imperialism, but this required united efforts. The first thing was to educate the people and let them have real peace. Canton desired first to put her house in order and set an example for others to follow and later, if necessary, she could send assistance to other provinces which needed her help. All obstacles to progress would be overcome in due time.

In connexion with the break with Hongkong, Gen. Wu expressed the hope that the matter would be completely and satisfactorily settled. Delegates had gone from Hongkong to Canton with a view to bringing about a settlement. It was not the aim of Canton to sever economic relations with Hongkong and the breach would never had occurred had it not been for the Shameen incident last June when more than 160 Chinese citizens were killed by the British and French and no redress had been made.

After this readers will scarcely wish for more of General Wu's opinions.

《字林西报》，1926年1月5日，星期二
（印：...）
第 6902 号
日期... 1926年1月5日

一位广州将军
谈广州局势

并无真正的布尔什维克主义：鲍罗廷
仅为顾问：赤色分子
致力于和平

“所谓广州是布尔什维克化、由鲍罗廷同志及其共产党人治理，或者蒋介石将军（粤军总司令）是‘赤色分子’的说法，完全毫无事实依据，”广州第一军军长兼广州市公安局长吴铁城将军在接受《字林西报》记者采访时说道。

吴将军指出，鲍罗廷同志仅仅是广州政府的政治顾问，对省政事务根本没有任何发言权。他可能对政府某些成员具有个人影响力，但这并不意味着他向政府发号施令。“我是政府的一员，”吴将军说，“但我绝不受鲍罗廷或任何其他外国人的支配。鲍罗廷作为政治顾问的地位赋予他提出建议的权利，但并未赋予他在行政管理上的权力。说他向政府发号施令是完全不实的。个别人士可能会听取他的建议，但那是他们自己的事。诚然，共产主义宣传正在南方传播，但这也是以个人方式进行的，并非由政府主导。”

并无真正的布尔什维克主义

将军继续说道：“真正的布尔什维克主义在广州并不存在。自革命以来，本省从未经历过如此般的和平与秩序。商业活动正常进行。如果存在布尔什维克主义，所有财产乃至妇女都将被国有化，所有建筑物和商店（如先施公司和太阳公司）等都将被疯狂的民众夺取。全省将陷入混乱状态。”

谈及蒋介石将军时，这位局长称他是一位真诚、勇敢、诚实且爱国的人，真正将中国人民的利益放在心上。指控他是布尔什维克分子的说法完全毫无事实依据。他的部下训练有素，许多人曾就读于黄埔军校，他们是优秀且纪律严明的战士。他们的行动并未激起民众的敌意。与其他部队不同，他们不采取勒索及其他非法征税手段。他们仅在被迫时才进行战斗，且通常都能获胜。他们渴望和平，希望维持和平。

那令人厌倦的旧枷锁

广州作为革命基地和反帝国主义堡垒，渴望实现国民革命，使中国人民摆脱外国人的枷锁。为了建立理想的政府，中国人必须消除军阀主义和帝国主义，但这需要共同努力。首要任务是教育民众，让他们享有真正的和平。广州希望首先整顿内部秩序，为其他地区树立榜样，随后如有必要，可向其他需要帮助的省份提供援助。所有阻碍进步的障碍终将在适当时候被克服。

关于与香港断交一事，吴将军表示希望此事能得到彻底且满意的解决。香港已派出代表前往广州，旨在促成和解。广州的目的并非切断与香港的经济关系，若非去年六月发生的沙基惨案——当时英法方面杀害了160多名中国公民且未给予任何赔偿——破裂本不会发生。

至此，读者恐怕不再想更多地了解吴将军的观点了。
